constraints.description: Eligible costs take the form of a lump sum as defined in the Decision of 7 July 2021 authorising the use of lump sum contributions under Horizon Europe. The topic overrides General Annex G with a lump-sum exception.
Project results are expected to contribute to ALL of the listed expected outcomes, not a subset. The binding is stated as 'all of the following expected outcomes'.
Proposals must earmark resources for cooperation with existing in-situ data collection frameworks, named as GBIF, OBIS and LUCAS.

In-situ data from Commission-steered biodiversity monitoring schemes is incorporated, named as LUCAS, specifically LUCAS grassland, and EMBAL (European Monitoring of Biodiversity in Agricultural Landscapes).

The project provides sufficient means for effective coordination with projects selected under the ESA FuturEO programme. The topic sits in the Biodiversity cluster of the EC-ESA Earth System Science Initiative (ESSI).
Demonstration cases align with reporting requirements under the Habitats Directive, the Birds Directive, the Marine Strategy Framework Directive and the EU Nature Restoration Regulation.
Demonstration cases ensure interoperability with European and global frameworks, specifically the Global Ecosystem Typology and EUNIS.
Proposals deliver FAIR data and link observation data to relevant data infrastructures, including, where applicable, the European Open Science Cloud (EOSC), the European Common Data Spaces and SAGE.
